skill.name: stockerpunk
skill.description: Check StockerPunk wallet readiness, inspect NFTs and pending NVDA rewards, and prepare mint or harvest transactions on BNB Chain.
skill.summary: Inspect StockerPunk NFTs and prepare transactions for explicit approval through Binance Agentic Wallet.
skill.author: stockerpunk

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts concern Markdown, JavaScript strings, fixed wallet queries, or expected public blockchain requests. The harvest preview command permits shell injection through an unvalidated sender argument, and readiness checks can report success despite missing information. No evidence found of credential theft, malicious network transfers, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: The harvest builder interpolates unvalidated sender input into a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Validate every sender as a 20-byte hexadecimal address, including mint inputs. Return structured executable arguments and use shell-free execution instead of command strings.

remediation.issue: Preflight can report READY when the wallet address, Agent ID status, or minted count is unknown.
remediation.suggestion: Return NOT_READY for missing addresses and failed RPC checks. Preserve unknown counts instead of zero, and require a successful eligibility check before building mints.

semantic_findings.title: Readiness Checks Fail Open on Unknown Wallet State
semantic_findings.description: Preflight can report READY with a missing wallet address or unknown Agent ID status. Failed minted-count reads leave zero, overstating available slots. Mint builders also accept unknown Agent ID results; this does not prove a bypass of on-chain enforcement.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both implementations reject only explicit false identity checks and suppress minted-count failures. The READY decision does not require a known address or successful chain checks.

content.user_title: Inspect StockerPunk NFTs and Prepare Transactions
content.value_statement: StockerPunk users need wallet readiness, NFT holdings, and reward information before approving transactions. This skill connects those checks with mint and harvest preparation through Binance Agentic Wallet.
actual_capabilities: Check wallet connection, Developer Mode, Agent ID status, and remaining mint slots through preflight.
Read collection mint progress, supply, mint price, and the configured wallet limit.
List wallet NFTs with rarity, mining weight, and pending NVDA reward amounts.
Build mint calldata and wallet preview commands for up to five NFTs, subject to remaining mint slots.
Build harvest calldata and a wallet preview command for a selected token identifier.
Expose collection, preflight, listing, mint-building, and harvest-building tools through an optional MCP server.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or later, network access, and Binance Agentic Wallet for connected-wallet workflows and transaction approval.
Builders do not sign transactions; the reviewed contracts and external wallet dependencies were not independently verified.
The CLI single-token command delegates to wallet listing without filtering by token identifier; reward amounts represent pending rewards, not verified account balances.
Readiness checks can accept unknown state, and generated sender command strings need validation before shell execution.

use_cases.title: Check Mint Eligibility
use_cases.description: Review wallet connection, Agent ID status, mint slots, and collection price before deciding whether to prepare a mint.

use_cases.title: Review NFT Rewards
use_cases.description: Compare held NFTs by rarity, mining weight, and reported pending NVDA rewards without submitting a transaction.

use_cases.title: Integrate Approval Workflows
use_cases.description: Use MCP tools to gather collection data and prepare transaction previews while retaining explicit wallet approval.

prompt_templates.title: Check Wallet Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my StockerPunk wallet readiness and explain each result. Treat unknown eligibility or failed checks as unresolved, and do not prepare transactions.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Holdings
prompt_templates.prompt: List my StockerPunk NFTs with token identifiers, rarity, mining weight, and pending NVDA rewards. Do not sign or submit anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Mint Preview
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a preview for minting two StockerPunk NFTs after checking eligibility and slots. Show the full recipient, BNB cost, and risks; await approval.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Harvest Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect token 42 in my holdings, validate all addresses, and prepare a harvest preview using structured wallet arguments. Explain costs and await explicit approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced reward workflow with input validation

output_examples.input: Explain a preflight result where Developer Mode is disabled.
output_examples.output: The wallet reports Developer Mode is disabled. Review this setting in the Binance App before contract calls. No transaction has been submitted.

output_examples.input: Show how reported NFT rewards would be summarized.
output: Illustrative result: Token 42 has Whale rarity, mining weight 8.0, and 0.5040 pending NVDA.
Illustrative result: Token 77 has Broker rarity, mining weight 2.5, and 0.1628 pending NVDA.
Pending amounts are reported contract values, not verified account balances or guaranteed future earnings.

output_examples.input: Explain what happens after preparing a harvest transaction.
output_examples.output: The builder prepares calldata and a preview command without signing. Validate addresses and inspect the transaction preview before approving execution through the wallet.

best_practices: Run preflight and resolve unknown or failed checks before preparing a transaction.
Validate full addresses and pass structured arguments instead of copying generated commands into a shell.
Review the chain, recipient, calldata, BNB value, and fees before explicitly approving wallet execution.
anti_patterns: Execute generated preview commands containing unchecked sender values or shell syntax.
Treat READY as proof of eligibility when the wallet address or chain checks are unknown.
Promise a rarity tier, guaranteed reward yield, or investment return.

faq.question: What do I need to use this skill?
faq.answer: Use Node.js 18 or later and the StockerPunk CLI. Connected-wallet operations require Binance Agentic Wallet; the MCP server is optional.

faq.question: Does the skill store private keys or sign transactions?
faq.answer: The reviewed CLI and MCP server do not store private keys or sign. They prepare transaction data for approval through the external wallet.

faq.question: Who can mint StockerPunk NFTs?
faq.answer: The workflow expects an Agentic Wallet holding a .ai Agent ID. The builder checks a five-mint wallet limit; verify eligibility and contract behavior independently.

faq.question: Is the first mint free?
faq.answer: The builder treats the first mint per wallet as free and reads the contract price for additional mints. Network fees can still apply.

faq.question: Can I inspect one token directly?
faq.answer: The CLI single-token command currently returns the wallet listing. Select the requested token from those results rather than assuming identifier filtering occurred.

faq.question: Are rewards guaranteed, and are generated commands safe?
faq.answer: Rewards are not guaranteed. Sender command strings require validation, and readiness results can omit failed checks; review transaction details before approving anything.
